profiles.shortDescription: NACOL develops and manufactures hydraulic accumulator technology and associated hydraulic components. Its official range includes bladder and piston accumulators, safety equipment, stop valves, fittings and water-hydraulic systems.
fullDescription: NACOL is the current corporate name of the business formerly known as Nippon Accumulator Co., Ltd.
The manufacturer-owned site documents accumulator systems and related hydraulic equipment, including bladder and piston designs, safety devices, valves, fittings and water-hydraulic solutions.

profiles.shortDescription: Nippon Oil Pump manufactures compact fluid-transfer and hydraulic products under the NOP name. Its official portfolio includes trochoid pumps, PROCON rotary vane pumps, hydraulic motors and filtration products.
fullDescription: Nippon Oil Pump's manufacturer-owned product directory establishes the NOP identity and its pump and hydraulic technology scope.
The documented range covers trochoid pumps, rotary vane pumps, hydraulic motors and filters for lubrication, cooling and fluid-handling duties.

profiles.shortDescription: NIVELCO develops process-measurement and control instruments. Its official portfolio covers level, pressure, flow and analytical measurement together with level switches and related control devices.
fullDescription: NIVELCO's manufacturer-owned site identifies a process-instrumentation company with a broad measurement portfolio.
Published product groups include continuous level measurement, level switching, pressure and flow measurement, analytical instrumentation and process-control accessories.

profiles.shortDescription: NKE develops factory-automation systems and components. Its official range includes assembly systems, conveyors, pneumatic grippers, distributed wiring products and control components.
fullDescription: NKE's first-party site documents an automation manufacturer serving production and material-transfer applications.
The published portfolio includes assembly equipment, conveyor modules, air grippers, Uniline distributed wiring and related automation components.

profiles.shortDescription: NMB Technologies supplies precision components within the MinebeaMitsumi group. Its official product directory covers miniature bearings, motors, fans and blowers, sensors, switches, connectors and power products.
fullDescription: NMB Technologies' first-party site establishes the NMB identity within the MinebeaMitsumi group.
The documented portfolio spans miniature ball bearings, electromechanical motors, cooling fans and blowers, sensing devices, switches, connectors and power supplies.

Published capabilities cover pneumatic conveying, material storage and discharge, weighing, batching, blending and control-system integration.

The documented product scope covers Absocoder absolute-position technology, rotary and linear sensors, cylinder-integrated sensing, tension measurement and associated controllers and software.
